study: O1h independent second grid: 30 largest Muslim populations x 21 worldwide methods, naked, calendar 2026

conventions.deviation: method minute minus target minute, wall clock, in the target timezone; reported as absolute value
conventions.rounding: computed at second resolution (Rounding.None), margins added, then the row direction applied; targets use the object direction, methods use the body documented direction else nearest
conventions.methodMargins: preset methods run with the preset only; non-preset methods run with the body published margins (JAKIM +2/+2, Kemenag +3/+3, ECFR -2/+2); census-measured margins are target-side only, per brief section "method side" last sentence
conventions.intervals: interval isha is printed maghrib + interval, the census measured invariant
conventions.highLatitude: methods keep the library default (middle of night) except MoonsightingCommittee (body curve) and ECFR (proportional, angle/60)
conventions.asr: flag only, never part of the score
